name: Awesome God
overview: Scripture reveals God as an awesome and incomparable being, characterized by His unchanging truth, perfect justice, and mighty power. He is not like man who lies or repents, but always fulfills His promises (Numbers 23:19). As the great and terrible God, He is sovereign over all creation, the Lord of lords and God of gods, who does not show partiality or accept bribes (Deuteronomy 10:17; Nehemiah 1:5). His works are perfect and just, sustaining the heavens and the earth, and inspiring awe and worship from all creation (Deuteronomy 32:4; Nehemiah 9:6; Psalms 66:3).
